caption: The drawing depicts a gray horse with a brown tail and black-tipped hooves, rearing up on its hind legs with its front hooves raised and mouth open. The horse is adorned with various pieces of tack and decorative elements: a green bridle with a red and gold circular ornament near the ear, yellow and green feathered or fringed decorations along the neck and rump, and a green saddle pad with yellow fringe and a red saddle blanket over it. There is a blue and green strap securing the saddle and a blue girth strap around the belly, both decorated with a golden buckle. Hanging from the saddle, on the horse’s left side, is a vertical object that appears to be a saber or sword with a gold hilt, wrapped at the top with multicolored bands. The background is plain and unadorned, consisting of a solid light beige or off-white color.
title: Carousel Horse
